asr.full_text: Have You Been In Crypto Since Last Cycle or Even Before? If you have been in Crypto since last cycle, or even before, you know Polygon has gone through a lot of changes, especially over the past few years. And apparently, a lot of people are confused about what Polygon is doing now. On top of that, so many missed the switch from Matic to Pole. Things might have been a little confusing but polygon is back in a big way but really they never even left because they've been working on crazy crazy partnerships building and really bridging that gap from web 2 to web 3 or vice versa and today i'm going to show you how polygon is positioning itself as one of the top networks for RWA stable coins and much, much more. I'm also going to explain how Pol l is the native token that powers all of this while delivering real value to holders. But first, thank you so much to Polygon Labs for partnering with the O Show Everything Crypto every single day. Now, make sure to go down to the description, follow them on X and check out their official website and literally day. Now let's go ahead and talk about how Polygon evolved from a simple Ethereum sidechain into a full ecosystem of interconnected blockchains focused on speed, scalability, and real-world adoption. The network was recently upgraded from 1,000 TPS with the Belai upgrade, delivering predictable low fees and sub-second finality, and the roadmap is super aggressive. We've already gone planning to hit 5,000 TPS soon, then 10,000 TPS, and eventually 100,000 TPS by 2026, which is around the corner. This scalability powers the Ag layer, Polygon's cross-chain Settlement layer that connects liquidity across all Chains for fast, low-cost interoperability. As Ethereum ecosystem users continue to migrate to Layer 2s, Polygon is the natural bridge, offering Ethereum-level security with far better speed and costs. Now, the MATIC to PoL transition is 99% complete, with the POL token fully live now. This upgrade makes PoL better for staking, government, and fueling the network's growth. The shift unlocks new utilities especially as pull powers transactions across the ag layer. Now let's first look at why pull is a game-changer for stablecoins and payments. Pull powers every stablecoin transaction on the network. And stablecoins are booming on Polygon with over 50% of ALL non USD stablecoins living on the network and total stablecoin TBL recently surpassed 3 billion dollars. Data from DUNE analystics also shows Polygon's dominance in stablecoin issuance and transfers. So with all of this, and with stablecoin adoption and usage surging in 2025, the POLE token is positioned as a key value driver for folders. Speaking of value, POLL stakers are earning some serious rewards. Projects like Katarna recently launched on mainnet with $1 billion dollar incentive pool, allocating 15% of the supply to their stakers. Projects like MINNAMIN, allocating around 10% of tokens to early users, alongside billions in privado, are offering airdrops to reward poll stakers, enhancing holder value even more. Polygon is positioning itself as a decent master call alternative for global payments, built for real-world use cases, handling cross-border and peer-to-peer transactions faster and more affordable than traditional systems. Plus, Polygon's partnerships and payment dominance are next level. Do you know that Polygon integrates with some of the world's biggest companies and financial institutions? MasterCard enables fiat to crypto rams, and Blackrock and Franklin-Temberton rolling out tokenized funds on Polygon. And when it comes to payments, Polygon outpaces all EVM chains including Ethereum, leading in micropayments and small payments, and ranking a close second in medium payments. Companies like Shopify, Strype, and Revolut are leveraging Polygon's network. Revolut enables seamless stablecoin spending for everyday purchases. And Strype has achieved significant milestones in Stablecoin transactions on Polygon. September's payment volume hit 463 million and is pushing for a new all-time high. Stripe alone has processed 50 million in lifetime stablecoin volume on Polygon via Paxos, proving money moves faster on Polygon. Plus, Polygon hired Jon Eggan, the previous head of crypto at Stripe and chief product officer. Egan leads Stripe's crypto enablement, and is now accelerating Polygon's global payments strategy. Bringing major industry expertise to help make Poll the backbone of Web3. Now let's talk about RWA's and Web3 apps. Polygon's total value locked hit, $1.23 billion in August. And that's a 43% increase year to date, reflecting real capital flowing in for payments, stable coins, and RWAs. rwa.xyz reported over 1 billion, secured on RWAs in Polygon, with a current snapshot showing around $720 million, TBL and 14 assets excluding stable coins holding a 4.1 percent market share which is insane. And the biggest rwa consumer app on Polygon courtyard.io allows users to tokenize and trade physical collectibles like pokemon and sports cards bridging the gap between physical and digital assets this is rwas anywhere around last cycle you know the bull market was kicked off by pokemon cards and crypto bros so this is something i will most definitely be checking out and yeah i partook in the pokemon card mania last cycle i think i broke even anyways poly market the world's largest prediction market is built on polygon pos PoS, handling massive volumes and offering instant settlements with super, super low fees. Honestly, PolyMarket is one of those really, really cool platforms that allows you to kind of get breaking news, market sentiment, and just in general, have an idea as to what's going on. Plus, it is crypto-related, powered by Polygon. From powering stablecoin payments at global scale to hosting huge tokenized funds, Polygon is laying the rails for real-world adoption. And it's not just about DeFi anymore. We're seeing RWAs, collectibles, payment apps, and enterprise use cases all coming to life on the network. With top companies like MasterCard, Stripe, Revolut, BlackRock, they're still building across the network. Polygon is going to be the go-to platform for real-value. Plus, Agler is making everything faster, more connected, and more efficient, with pull at the very center. With major upgrades and new leadership from Stripe's former head of crypto and an aggressive roadmap ahead, Polygon is ready to lead the next wave of crypto adoption in my personal opinion. And yes I know this was a lot of information so make sure to go to their socials, follow them on X, go to the website and really just check out their entire ecosystem and take your time because they are going to continue to grow and you need to become as well-versed as possible. Thank you guys so much for watching and have a good rest of your day you
